land.text: Antalya and the Teke Peninsula, the part of the Hamidid lands held by the Teke branch

predecessors.note: 'established by a branch of the Hamidid dynasty in 1321'. Cliopatria's Hamid shape of 1305-1325 (57,555 km2) still contains this land; its 1326 shape (30,933 km2) is the Hamidid remainder.

land.text: the Teke lands, formerly Seljuk (Antalya taken by the Seljuks in 1207)

successors.note: 'In 1423, the Ottomans definitively re-annexed the beylik'. Cliopatria's Ottoman shape contains none of the Teke land in 1425-1427 and all of it in 1429.

capitals.name: Antalya
capitals.note: 'Its capital was Antalya.' Cypriot rule at Antalya 1361-1373 and Ottoman annexation 1391-1402 interrupt the seat; the pages do not name a refuge capital.

correction.text: Antalya and the Teke Peninsula, held by the Teke branch of the Hamidids; the 1326 shape is the nearest outline

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 1321-1325, before Cliopatria's row. 'established by a branch of the Hamidid dynasty in 1321' (infobox 'Established: 1321'; Cliopatria starts 1326). The page names only Antalya and the Teke Peninsula, so the 1326 shape is used. Cliopatria's Hamid shape of 1305-1325 still includes this land (the Hamid dossier should exclude it).

30,773 km2 for 1326-1332: Antalya (capital, 'The peninsula west of Antalya is called Teke Peninsula') with parts of Burdur, Isparta and Mugla provinces. The page gives no area and no towns beyond Antalya; Hizir Bey's reign begins 1327 in its table.
30,749 km2 for 1333-1351: 25 km2 smaller than 1326, a boundary adjustment; the page is silent. The Germiyanids appear as a neighbour from 1333 in Cliopatria.

correction.text: shape unchanged, valid 1352-1360; from August 1361 Antalya is Cypriot (keyframe beylik-of-teke_1363)

keyframe_review.note: 30,772 km2 for 1352-1362: the shape stands for 1352-1360 only. 'On 23 August 1361, Cypriot forces landed in Antalya and Peter conquered the city after a siege on 24 August 1361'; Antalya is Cypriot from then (see the 1363 keyframe). Ledger events carry the loss.

correction.text: shape unchanged, valid 1361-1373, without the Cypriot city of Antalya

keyframe_review.note: 29,607 km2 for 1363-1374: 1,141 km2 smaller than the neighbouring shapes (the gazetteer shows three fewer cells within 30 km of Antalya), which matches Cypriot Antalya: 'a period of Cypriot rule between 1361 and 1373'. The years are wrong: it should run 1361-1373. Cliopatria's Kingdom of Cyprus shape of 1363-1486 contains three cells of the Antalya coast through 1486, though Cypriot rule at Antalya ended in 1373.

correction.text: shape unchanged, valid 1375-1390 and 1402-1421; 1391-1401 the land is Ottoman

keyframe_review.note: 30,749 km2 for 1375-1421, Antalya again Teke after 1373. It stands for 1375-1390 and 1402-1421 only: 'During the reign of the last ruler, Othman, the Ottoman Empire annexed the beylik in 1391' (the Antalya page also has the Ottomans in 1391) and 'during his invasion of Anatolia in 1402, Timur restored Othman to his rule'. Cliopatria's Ottoman shape contains none of the Teke land in 1395 (checked), so 1391-1401 is left empty by Cliopatria.

correction.text: shape unchanged, valid for 1422 only; from 1423 Ottoman

keyframe_review.note: 30,749 km2 for 1422-1428, but the beylik ends in 1423: 'In 1423, the Ottomans definitively re-annexed the beylik' (infobox 'Disestablished: 1423'). Cliopatria's Ottoman shape contains none of the Teke land in 1425-1427 and all of it in 1429 (checked), so 1424-1428 would be empty unless the Ottoman row is corrected or this shape is kept as Ottoman-held (occupation).

ledger.note: 1321: a Hamidid branch founds the Teke beylik at Antalya. The beylik was 'established by a branch of the Hamidid dynasty in 1321'; 'One brother, Yunus Bey, became the first ruler of the Teke beylik'; 'Its capital was Antalya.'

August 1361: Peter I of Cyprus takes Antalya. 'On 23 August 1361, Cypriot forces landed in Antalya and Peter conquered the city after a siege on 24 August 1361.' The emir of Antalya, Teke, tried to retake it but the Cypriots kept it.

1373: Cypriot rule at Antalya ends. 'except for a period of Cypriot rule between 1361 and 1373'; the page does not say who took the city back, so the Teke beylik (its holder before and after) is my reading.

1391: Bayezid I annexes the Teke beylik. 'During the reign of the last ruler, Othman, the Ottoman Empire annexed the beylik in 1391' (the Antalya page: 'the Ottoman Empire in 1391'; the Bayezid page lists Teke among the 'remaining beyliks' overwhelmed, undated).

1402: Timur restores Othman to Teke. 'during his invasion of Anatolia in 1402, Timur restored Othman to his rule'; Bayezid lost the Battle of Ankara on 20 July 1402 (Bayezid I page) and the page says many beyliks 'regained their independence'.
1423: the Ottomans annex Teke for good. 'In 1423, the Ottomans definitively re-annexed the beylik'; infobox 'Disestablished: 1423'.
1423: the Teke beylik ends. 'lasted until 1423, when it was permanently annexed by the Ottoman Empire'. Cliopatria keeps the row to 1428.

wars.name: Cypriot conquest of Antalya
wars.outcome: Peter I conquered Antalya on 24 August 1361; the emir of Antalya, Teke, 'after many attacks tried to occupy his city' but failed; Cypriot rule lasted until 1373.
wars.note: The Peter I page does not date the end of Cypriot rule (the Antalya page gives 1373) and records a garrison revolt over unpaid wages in May 1367.

wars.name: Ottoman annexation of Teke
wars.outcome: Bayezid I annexed the beylik in 1391; Timur restored Othman in 1402; the Ottomans annexed it again in 1423.
wars.note: No campaign is described on the Teke page; the Bayezid page dates only the 1390 conquest of Aydin, Saruhan and Menteshe.

wars.name: Battle of Ankara
wars.outcome: 'In the fateful Battle of Ankara, on 20 July 1402, the Ottoman army was defeated'; Timur restored the beys, among them Othman of Teke.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line; the Taurus and Lycian highland frontiers with Karaman, Hamid, Germiyan and Menteshe are approximate.

notes: Pages: five (budget 5). Start 1321 and end 1423 are the infobox's against Cliopatria's 1326 and 1428. Cliopatria rows to correct elsewhere: Hamid 1305-1325 still contains the Teke land; Kingdom of Cyprus 1363-1486 contains three cells at Antalya though Cypriot rule ended in 1373 (so the Antalya cells are held by both Cyprus and, from 1375, the Teke shape); the Ottoman Empire shape holds none of the Teke land in 1391-1401 (while Ottoman) or 1424-1428 and all of it in 1429, so the Ottoman dossier (me-10) should carry the 1391-1402 and 1423 gains. The Teke page does not mention the Cypriot conquest of 1361, Karamanid relations, Korkuteli or Alanya; the Antalya page does not say who retook Antalya in 1373 (my reading: the beylik). The Bayezid and Murad II pages date no Teke event; the Murad II page only mentions the annexation of Teke without a year, so the 1423 date rests on the Teke page. The Teke page gives the first ruler as Yunus Bey and Hizir Bey's reign from 1327; no full list was extracted, so identity.rulers is omitted. Natural Earth place 'Antalya' and admin1 names resolve.
